bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 受阻于 $268 下方，RSI 超买

read.en: Zscaler closed flat on Oct 27 at $260.15, trading between $255.32 and $267.87, after six straight gains. It is above all its rising averages: 5-day ($249.0), 10-day ($232.1), 30-day ($215.7), 100-day ($173.4) and 200-day ($166.4). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 22 and above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 22 ($209.46), and RSI is 73.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月27日收平于 $260.15，盘中区间 $255.32–267.87，此前连涨六日。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$249.0）、10 日（$232.1）、30 日（$215.7）、100 日（$173.4）和 200 日均线（$166.4）。MACD 自 10月22日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看多（$209.46），RSI 为 73。

read.en: A push to $267.9 faded, closing under the $261.5 Oct 26 high; RSI is above 70 for a third day. Resistance is $261.5, then $267.9–270.1 (Oct 27 high, Nov 26, 2025 high) and $289.7. Support is $255.3–255.6 (Oct 27 low, Oct 23 high), then $249–250 (5-day, round number) and $241.2. A close above $268 would target $270–290; a close below $255 would open $250.
